description.text:
Miracle Journey (奇迹启程) was a Scarlet & Violet booster in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 21 March 2025 in 5-card packs with one holo and 20-card packs with six. Gardevoir ex is on its cover: its Ability, Psychic Embrace, attaches a basic Psychic Energy from the discard pile to one of your Psychic Pokémon, which then takes two damage counters, as many times a turn as you like.

The final forms of the Paldea starters arrived as Pokémon ex, Meowscarada ex, Skeledirge ex and Quaquaval ex, with Squawkabilly ex, Grafaiai ex, Paldean Clodsire ex and Mabosstiff ex, and the Trainers Erika's Invitation, Artazon, Letter of Encouragement and Rigid Band. Common, Uncommon and Rare cards also come as Poké Ball pattern and Master Ball pattern holos. The day before release, Pokémon China noted that a picture on the display box of 5-card packs and the outer box of 20-card packs had been printed wrong. Its main cards are numbered out of 128; Art Rare, full-art, Special Art Rare and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 163.
